instruction: According to the ACT, for 2023 identify of all the states to have an estimated at least 90% of their grads tested using the ACT, which of those states had a composite average score of at least 18.5, had at least 42% of test takers meet the English benchmark, had at least 19% meet the math benchmark, and at least 30% meet the reading benchmark.

task_metadata.problem: According to the ACT, for 2023 identify of all the states to have an estimated at least 90% of their grads tested using the ACT, which of those states had a composite average score of at least 18.5, had at least 42% of test takers meet the English benchmark, had at least 19% meet the math benchmark, and at least 30% meet the reading benchmark.
task_metadata.answer: Kentucky, Wyoming, Montana, Arkansas, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Utah

codex_difficulty.label: easy

difficulty_rationale.summary: Easy: the worker produced a locally correct or partially correct answer in 4 actions, below the five-action threshold.

representative_actions: Searched ACT’s website for 2023 state-level participation, composite scores, and benchmark percentages.
Opened ACT’s official two-page 2023 Average ACT Scores by State PDF and reviewed its complete table.
Rendered the first PDF page to visually confirm the relevant high-participation rows.
